issue.title: test_prompt_panel_header.py two tests fail on master expecting 'SASE CONTEXT' section
issue.description: Running tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_header.py on a clean master checkout (093088abb, verified via git stash) fails 2 of the module's tests: test_header_renders_skill_uses_without_memory_reads and test_family_header_renders_followup_role_attribution. Both assert 'SASE CONTEXT\n' in build_header_text(...)'s rendered plain text, but the actual output has no SASE CONTEXT section at all (header stops after the Timestamps line). Reproduce with: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_header.py -q. Discovered while implementing the silent_monitors plan (monitor notification-neutrality) and running just test-scoped on an otherwise-unrelated diff; confirmed unrelated via git stash.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by epic sase-l6 phase sase-l6.4 (2026-08-13T22:13:54Z, base commit 932277b26): tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_header.py::test_header_renders_skill_uses_without_memory_reads and ::test_family_header_renders_followup_role_attribution fail only when run after test_header_renders_workflow_variables_before_agent_context in the same process; pass in isolation. Confirmed pre-existing via git stash on 932277b26 (same 2 failures, byte-identical), unrelated to sase-l6.4's streaming-lane change.

payload.entry: Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (master 443566f7d, workspace sase_13): '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_panel_header.py -q' -> 9 passed, and a -k run of the two nodes named in this bead (test_header_renders_skill_uses_without_memory_reads, test_family_header_renders_followup_role_attribution) -> 2 passed. The SASE CONTEXT section is present again after epic sase-l6's enrichment work landed. The nodes still appear in 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' only from pre-fix full-run records, which age out on the 30-day retention window.

payload.close_reason: Fixed on master; both named tests pass.
